RBI to Sell Rs 25,000 Crore Bonds to Drain Liquidity

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced it will sell government bonds worth Rs 25,000 crore on September 28 as part of measures to drain liquidity from the system. This follows an earlier action where the RBI absorbed ₹75,026 crore through an overnight VRRR auction amid surplus liquidity.
